Jordan and Casey watch nothing.

watchlists.$comment: Keyed by the account a member's session resolves to (the watchlist route's key): Eric's first account. Names the world quotes (bot-loop-today's market).

market.$comment: The 11 sector funds R&D's Coverage reads a month of (coverage-route.ts → sectorFunds), added to bot-loop-today's market so the column renders as production's does with a linked account. Levels and vols are sanitized; each fund's month is market.mjs's deterministic walk, no claim to be a real tape (rd-artifacts.mjs says so).
